The thinking is done by a model you choose and pay for.

While a task runs, everything the agent reads is sent to the endpoint you set up, with your key: the text of every screen it looks at, element labels and resource ids, any notification text on screen, the name and label of every installed app, and every app function this phone publishes. The app list and the function list go once per task even if the agent never opens those apps. Screen contents go on every step as text, and as a PNG if you turn screenshots on. Password fields are the one thing left out.

Nothing is kept on the phone: no transcript is written to disk, and the activity log records only the method, the model id and why a task ended. What the endpoint does with what it receives is between you and that provider. BestROM runs none of them and receives none of it. A llama.cpp or Ollama server on your own network is the setup that sends nothing off it.
